# Layer order

<!-- Generated by `python -m kernel.docs_plane --write` from kernel/layer_order.yaml; do not edit by hand. -->

Layer order version **1.8** (kernel LBN-2.4, envelope MGRAPH-1.2). The step IDs carry the order: a step reads only what the steps before it wrote, and writes only its own paths (`check_pass_writes`, WRITE_SCOPE). The Layer column is the owner's corrected list (O57, O58); the Band column is the repo's own grouping.

Rules this table enforces: constraints come before beats (S03 before S04); temporal and causal are separate steps on shared beats; the UGC layers run only for `ugc_ad`; facial runs only for live action and UGC (O57); camera comes after effort and reads it; render (L6) and post-generation (L6.5) are terminal and have nodes only, as do intent (L0, a document) and brief (L0.5) (O58). A check goes at the first step that can see its data (plan v1.2).

| Step | Node | Layer | Band | Runs for | Writes nodes | Writes edges | Other paths | Depends on | Validated by | Code |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S01 | `intent` | L0 | L0 | all | — | — | `/intent` | — | schema | [p01_intent.py](../compiler/passes/mandatory/p01_intent.py) |
| S02 | `brief` | L0.5 | L0.5 | all | entities, props, surfaces | — | `/scene` | intent | schema, coherence | [p02_brief.py](../compiler/passes/mandatory/p02_brief.py) |

## Changing the layer order

Never by hand. A change needs an accepted ADR (docs/decisions/), then an edit of `kernel/layer_order.yaml`, its kernel log entry (`python -m kernel.schema_log --log kernel record kernel/layer_order.yaml ...`), the version bump in the file, and `make docs`. `scripts/verify.sh` refuses the rest.
